tagline: The World's Leading Movie Exhibition Company
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA is the key profitability KPI for AMC, reflecting operational performance amid a complex financial restructuring context

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operational profitability metric adjusted for non-recurring items
kpis.description: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA reflecting AMC and Muvico's operational performance. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data spanning the last 19 years.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total revenue including ticketing, concessions, and other theater-related income
kpis.description: Consolidated total revenue from all theatrical activities

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net loss after taxes and financial charges
kpis.description: Consolidated net loss reflecting high financial expenses and restructuring costs

kpis.name: Number of Cinemas
kpis.explanation: Total number of cinemas operated by AMC in the United States and Europe
kpis.description: Total number of cinemas operated, including AMC Group and Muvico Group

kpis.name: Number of Screens
kpis.explanation: Total number of movie screens operated
kpis.description: Total number of screens operated across the AMC network

kpis.name: Attendance
kpis.explanation: Total number of moviegoers hosted in AMC cinemas
kpis.description: Total number of attendees at screenings in 2025

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.02 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €8.14 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Average Ticket Price
kpis.explanation: Average price paid per attendee for admission
kpis.description: Consolidated average ticket price reflecting geographic and product mix

risks.title: Liquidity Risk and Restructuring
risks.summary: The company may face liquidity shortfalls, requiring a restructuring of its liabilities, which could result in a total loss for shareholders.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is highlighted at the beginning of the document (Item 1A) with strong language ('total loss of their investment', 'restructuring of our liabilities'). It is weighted under the 'Capital' category due to the severity of potential consequences. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: High Leverage and Liquidity Constraints
risks.summary: The company's high level of indebtedness and current liquidity constraints limit its ability to repay debt and pursue opportunities, affecting investment recovery.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is strongly emphasized in the text ('substantial level of indebtedness', 'current liquidity constraints') and directly impacts repayment capacity and investment opportunities. The 'Capital' category is relevant, and severity is high. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Changes in the Film Industry and Competition
risks.summary: Shifts in consumer behavior (streaming, PVOD) and reduced film production threaten traditional theatrical exhibition.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with multiple factors such as streaming, shrinking exclusivity windows, and lower film output. It is classified under 'Industrial' with high severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Extreme Stock Volatility and Dilution
risks.summary: The company's shares experience extreme volatility and potential dilution, which may lead to substantial investor losses.
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions 'significant recent dilution' and 'extreme volatility' of shares, with direct impact on price and investor value. The 'Capital' category is appropriate, and severity is significant. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Information Systems and Cybersecurity Risks
risks.summary: Failures, unavailability, or security breaches of information systems could disrupt operations.
risks.score_rationale: 'Failures, unavailability or security breaches of our information systems' are cited as an operational risk. The 'Cybersecurity' category is most relevant, with moderate but potentially material severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Key Personnel and Talent Retention
risks.summary: Future performance depends on the ability to attract and retain key employees, particularly senior executives.
risks.score_rationale: 'Dependence on key personnel' and the ability to 'attract and retain senior executives' are identified as operational risks. The 'Key Person' category is direct, with moderate severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Global Economic Conditions and Inflation
risks.summary: Global economic conditions, including recession and inflation, may reduce consumers' disposable income and impact company revenues.
risks.score_rationale: 'General and international economic, political, regulatory, social and financial market conditions, including potential economic recession, inflation' are cited as regulatory risks but directly affect moviegoers' discretionary income. The 'Macro' category is more appropriate, with high severity. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in AMC's 10-K filing.
